design.installationScope: Both addons installed and loaded alongside the user's existing addon set; only the measured addon's main window open.
design.source: tests/live_compare.lua; second trial changes only targetName to meetingstone.
design.attribution: Native per-addon CPU and memory counters. LycheeGroup is the sum of all four packages; embedded dependencies stay with their native owner.
limits: Online results and result-update event counts vary between trials.
The two addons apply their own display rules; returned and displayed counts are retained separately.
Memory is the highest refreshed sample, not an unsampled upper bound or process/native texture memory.
CPU is cumulative during the measured window with scriptProfile=1; warmup and login loading are excluded.
No explicit garbage collection was performed; observer refresh cost is reported separately.

measurement.memory: refreshed GetAddOnMemoryUsage per package, simultaneous sum; KB*1024/1000000 MB
refreshed GetAddOnMemoryUsage per package, simultaneous sum; KB*1024/1000000 MB
